Why Geeb

Built for trust, speed, and a job done right

Three Apps, One Platform

Customer, vendor, and admin apps share a single Flutter codebase, monorepo, and shared package — consistent UX, faster iteration, and easier scaling across every service category.

Trending Vendors & Smart Discovery

Curated discovery surfaces the most relevant, highest-rated providers, with a personalized home screen and quick access to categories — so customers never have to guess who to hire.

Hierarchical Area System

Multi-level geographic organization (city → district → neighborhood) for accurate local discovery, smart job routing, and vendors serving exactly the right service areas.

Verified Pros, Secure Auth & 2FA

Background-checked, ID-verified pros. Customers can opt into Google OAuth and Two-Factor (TOTP); vendors get a streamlined OTP email verification flow with a guided signup and pending-verification recovery.

Reviews & Ratings v2.1

Automatic rating calculation at service and vendor level, real-time UI refresh in both customer and vendor apps, and cross-app updates via smart polling — all secured by PostgreSQL Row-Level Security.

Offline-First Vendor App

Hive-based local caching, background data sync for profiles, services, areas, and notifications, plus 5-minute refresh intervals — so vendors keep working even on shaky connections.

FAQ

Questions, answered

What kinds of services can I book on Geeb?
Plumbing, electrical, carpentry, painting, appliance repair, AC service, cleaning, pest control, handyman jobs, and more. New categories are added every month as pros join the platform.
How are service pros verified?
Every pro submits government ID, trade certificates (where applicable), and passes a background check. We also collect reviews after every job so quality stays high.
When do I pay?
You don't pay until the job is finished and you approve the work. Funds are held in escrow by Geeb and released to the pro on your confirmation — so you're never out of pocket for unfinished work.
How do I become a service pro on Geeb?
Tap 'Become a Pro' on the home page, complete the application (ID, trade details, service area), and our team reviews it within 48 hours. Once approved, you can set your schedule and start receiving job requests.
Does Geeb work offline?
Yes — the vendor app is offline-first, using Hive-based local caching. Vendors can manage offerings, areas, and notifications even without an active connection, and changes sync automatically when they're back online.
How is my data secured?
All sensitive data is protected by Supabase Row-Level Security policies. Customers and vendors can opt into Two-Factor Authentication (TOTP), and the entire platform is built with security-first principles from day one.
